findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed multiple cold held temperature control for food safety (TCS) foods in the open air cooler to have an internal temperature above 41F:
1) Hard boiled eggs had an ambient temperature of 51F, and probed at 45F. Three total packages of hard boiled eggs (two were in compliance) were probed for internal temperatures and voluntarily discarded by the person in charge (PIC). 
2) Two containers of Chobani yogurt were probed and one had an internal temperatures of 45F (the other had an internal temperature that was in compliance). Both containers were voluntarily discarded by the PIC.
3) Egg and dill salad sandwich and carrot cake had ambient temperatures of 48F. When probed they had internal temperature that were in compliance, however were discarded to be probed.
CORRECTED- probed items were discarded, and items in the open air cooler were pushed backwards. Ambient thermometers in the cooling unit show proper cold holding temperatures. Ensure all TCS items are monitored to be cold holding at 41F or less.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. [P]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed caulking around mop sink to contain an accumulation of black soil debris. Ensure caulking is cleaned and replace by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
The under counter cooler near the roller grillers was observed holding an ambient temperature of 50F. Hardboiled eggs inside were observed at 47F and were voluntarily discarded. Other foods were observed at 45F (humus, cookie dough, yogurt drinks) and were moved to a functioning cooler. Ensure the cooler is working properly to hold foods at 41F or below.
4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Cardboard is currently used to cover the drain in the soft serve dispenser area. Replace the cardboard and use a material that is smooth, easily cleanable, and nonabsorbent.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]
